description: Links whose clients' DHCP requests the router relays to DHCP servers elsewhere, DHCPv4 to the IPv4 servers and DHCPv6 to the IPv6 ones.

interfaces.description: Links the clients ask on, each by its full name, without a glob: links of one VRF, each of which a Network document matching it by Name= alone gives a static address of each family the servers have, a global one for IPv6. A link takes one relay.

servers.description: Unicast addresses of the DHCP servers, which the router reaches through the links' VRF: IPv4 servers get the links' DHCPv4 requests and IPv6 servers their DHCPv6 requests. A DHCPv6 server answers relayed requests on such an address, as Kea's does on an interface given as <name>/<address>.

x-chalkos-rules.description: A relay's servers are unicast addresses.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the server " + self.filter(a, ["0.0.0.0/8", "127.0.0.0/8", "169.254.0.0/16", "224.0.0.0/3", "::/8", "fe80::/10", "ff00::/8"].exists(r, cidr(r).contains(ip(a))))[0] + " is no unicast address a relay forwards to"

title: DHCPRelay
